description: Read-only query of LambdaTest automation resources: list builds, get one build, list the sessions in a build, fetch test details, and retrieve test logs (command, network, console, selenium, instrumentation). Supported combinations: build with list or get (web), session with list (web), test with get (web or app), logs with get and a logType (web or app). logType "instrumentation" returns XCUI and Espresso test logs. Renaming, stopping and deleting builds are separate tools: updateBuild, stopBuild and deleteBuild.

action.description: The read to perform: list, or get one

buildId.description: Build ID — required for build get, optional filter for session list

logType.description: Log type — required when resource is "logs"

pageNumber.description: Page number for command log pagination

platform.description: The platform type: "web" for browser automation, "app" for mobile app automation

sessionId.description: Session ID — required for app platform log retrieval

testId.description: Test ID — required for test get and logs get

name: automationQuery
title: Automation Query
